senses.gloss: m. (collare) collar, (Roman) prisoner’s band or chain around the neck.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:1:5">Y. Ned. IX, beg. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>הנודר … ק׳ על צוארו</he> he who makes a vow is like one putting a collar around his neck.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:1:5">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>לקוסטודיא … וראה ק׳ אחד פנוי וכ׳</he> it is as if a guard passed by (with prisoners), and some one seeing a collar vacant would put his head into it.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 6:5">Gitt. VI, 5</cite> <he>היוצא בק׳ וכ׳</he> if one is led out in chains (a prisoner) and says, write ye a letter of divorce &c.; Y. ib. 48ᵃ bot. <he>לא סוף דבר בק׳ של סכנה אלא אפי׳ בק׳ של ממון</he> this refers not only to a prisoner in danger (to be tried for his life), but also to a prisoner to be tried for a money matter; <he>שכל הק׳ וכ׳</he> for every prisoner is to be considered in danger of his life. Bab.
<cite ref="Gittin 65b:16">ib. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>גניבא יוצא בק׳ הוה</he> G’niba was taken prisoner; (Y.

<cite ref="Gittin 65b:16">ib.</cite> l. c. <he>אתאפק למתקטלא</he>). Lam. R. introd. (R. Z’ʿera) <he>העביר ק׳ מצוארו וכ׳</he> he (King Hosea) removed the collar (of responsibility) from his neck, and put it on the neck of the people &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 236">Yalk. Kings 236</cite>.

Snh. 7ᵇ, a. e. עשרה … ק׳ תלוי וכ׳ if ten men sit in court, the responsibility rests upon every one of them; a. fr.—Pl. קוֹלָרִים, קוֹלָרִין.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. X, 10 מפיל בקולרים, v. קְלִירוֹס.]—Y. Ber. VII, 11ᶜ (Daniel said,) בניו … בק׳ וכ׳ His children are in chains (in the Babylonian exile), where is His strength (that we should say הגבור)? (Yoma 69ᵇ נכרים משתעבדים בבניו). Yalk. l. c. אחר מפלתו … שבאו עמו בק׳ וכ׳ after the downfall of Sennacherib Ezekiah arose and freed all the people that had come with him in chains (the Egyptian prisoners) &c.; a. e.—Trnsf. a chain of men, gang.
Yeb. 122ᵃ ק׳ של בני אדם וכ׳ a party of men travelling to Antiochia; Tosef. ib. XIV, 7 קוֹלָאר (Var. קולר).—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 72b:14">Kidd. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ ק׳</he> Ar. (ed. only once <he>ק׳</he>), a Var. to <he>צוורני</he> (v. Rashi a. l.), v. <cite ref="R00178"><he>צוְורָנָא</he></cite>.
